name: OpenTelemetry Demo (Astronomy Shop)
goal: Buy three National Park Foundation Explorascopes, one for each of your kids. Before you pay, check the cart: the quantity, the price, shipping and the Total must add up. If they don't, don't pay; leave and say why.

defect.summary: The cart Total ignores quantity: src/frontend/components/CartItems/CartItems.tsx adds up each line's unit price without multiplying by quantity. Shipped through release 2.1.3, fixed upstream by 3e7498db (#2660).
defect.reproduce: Open http://localhost:8080/product/OLJCESPC7Z, choose quantity 3, tap Add To Cart. The cart shows Quantity 3, Price $101.96, Shipping $26.97 and Total $128.93 instead of $332.85.

buildGate: the frontend's type check and lint in next build, inside the 2.1.3 frontend image build
